summary: Cloudflare OAuth login establishes an account-scoped web session, with encrypted cookies and Durable Object-backed session revocation/profile checks.
trigger: Browser opens the cloudflare login route and returns to the OAuth callback.

steps.action: Create state and PKCE verifier, redirect to Cloudflare OAuth, and seal short-lived flow claims in a secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie.
Validate callback code/state/cookie and expiry; exchange code and retrieve identity profile.
Resolve immutable account ID from issuer-qualified identity, persist profile and HMAC digest of a new expiring session, then issue purpose-separated encrypted session cookie.
For authenticated requests, decrypt claims, enforce expiry and optional Origin/CSRF checks, then verify server-side session is live; logout revokes it and closes matching client relays.
